The Storm is merciless upon both our us and our enemies. In order to survive, we need to activate as many batteries at the protective device as possible. Those could be found in various places around the location. Stealing them directly from the enemy base works nicely too.
What you've been up to before the epidemic? Maybe you set traps for animals in the woods? The time has come to remember your skills, only this time your game is man!

Take it from me, there is no better gift than a good grenade. Especially without safery pins! And if you're good enough you can give one gift to several enemies! Just try not to give such gifts to your team.

Cool cowboy boots. Used to be a must-have for rockers and bikers before the catastrophe.

Low leather boots, provide good leg protection. At the Black Market base they are produced by the master named Spider who adds his trademark to every boot when manufacturing them. Their comfort helps you save stamina when sprinting.
Mighty cowboy boots with iron inlets and strips. They are the indicator of status among all the Black Market gangs.
Leather fingerless gloves. Handy in fights, when using firearms, or just filling your pipe before the long journey. Increase the reload rate by 2%.
Heavy, powerful gloves reinforced by metal spikes. Will come in handly when you run out of bullets and the outcome of battle is decided by brawl.
A leather biker's helmet. Protects the head against heavy objects hits. Such a helmet is a must-have at the time of Black Market fighters' conflicts.

Classic durable pants made from denim fabric. They help protect your legs against cold. Procured with toiling marauder's effort from a looted store. Pockets provide room for a couple traps or grenades.
Modified heavy-duty jeans with protective knee plates. Protect the legs against cold and injuries.
A sleeveless biker jacket. The outfit of rank for Black Market combatants. Protects from cold and tough weather. The jacket has special pockets for extra ammo, traps and grenades.

A heavy riveted jacket of thick leather with protective plate inlets. Originally was used by exquisitely big Black Market fighters, from where the name derives. The stylized skull on the arm demonstrates the owner's fearlessness in the face of death.

A heavy leather jacket of the Black Market assault fighter. It is reinforced with metal plates. The look of an assaulting combatant in Corsair is able to deliver shock and awe even upon an experienced survivor. Contains special pockets for extra ammo, traps and grenades.
